versions.changelog:
- Updated skill name to "rollinggo-searchhotel" and changed homepage URL to rollinggo.store.
- Enforced strict API Key presence check; added user-friendly guidance when missing.
- Changed environment variable for API Key from AIGOHOTEL_API_KEY to ROLLINGGO_API_KEY.
- Added new reference file: references/claw-host-env.md.
- Defaulted to always use the latest CLI version for all installations and executions.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of the "book-hotels" skill.
- Enables hotel search, detailed info, and room pricing using the RollingGo CLI.
- Supports queries by destination, date, budget, star rating, tags, and distance.
- Allows filtering with hotel tags, real-time room price lookup, and structured hotel comparisons.
- Integrates booking links in results for direct booking.
- Supports both npm/npx and uv/uvx environments for installation and execution.
